snippet.title: My Candy Love: NewGen - Official trailer video
snippet.description:
Pre-register now on your mobile devices and receive the Flying High outfit, a matching room decor, and, of course, an outfit for your favorite goose, the D.B. Gooser!

Explore the colorful streets of Amoris, discover the coolest office in the whole city, and most of all, get to know your attractive coworkers, become friends with them, or even more... Or perhaps you'll let yourself fall for your rival?

See you soon on My Candy Love: NewGen
